hero.eyebrow: Pete Guzzo, Executive Producer + Operations Strategist
hero.title: I'm the guy companies bring in when content, production, marketing, operations, studios, and business strategy are all tangled together, and someone needs to pull the team together and make it work.
hero.body: I help brands, agencies, studios, founders, and production teams turn messy ideas into executable content systems, productions, studios, campaigns, and business outcomes.

services.heading: What I actually do
services.intro: I'm not just a video guy, a marketer, a producer, or a consultant. Most of what I do is the part nobody sees: building the plan, running the production, fixing the workflow, and connecting the creative to the business outcome it's supposed to drive.

items.title: Executive Production
items.body: I run productions end to end, budget, crew, timeline, client, so the work actually gets across the line.

items.title: Production Operations
items.body: I build the systems and workflows that make repeatable output possible, not just one good shoot.

items.title: Content + Marketing Strategy
items.body: I connect what gets made to what actually moves the business, KPIs, not just views.

items.title: Studio Strategy + Operations
items.body: I design studios as operating systems, built for output and revenue, not just for looking good on a tour.

items.title: Business / Media Consulting
items.body: When the issue isn't creative, it's ownership, timeline, or communication, I help fix that too.

whoHiresMe.heading: Who hires me
whoHiresMe.body: Brands and agencies with too many moving parts and no single operating plan. Founders building a studio who don't want to learn that lesson the expensive way. Production teams that need someone who can sit with executives, crews, vendors, and owners, and keep the thing moving.

currentProjects.title: Unrested: Echoes from the Grave
currentProjects.body: A documentary project. Pete is working on it with his brother Paul Guzzo, whose lane is investigative journalism.

currentProjects.title: Shear Media Studios
currentProjects.body: An 11,000 sq. ft. multi-studio facility Pete designed and now runs, soundstages, podcast and influencer suites, live-shopping environments, built as a working revenue system, not just a nice room.

currentProjects.title: Greg Muzzillo — Dream Big
currentProjects.body: I sat down with Greg Muzzillo, founder of Proforma, for a new piece we're finishing now. Business, leadership, risk, and what it actually takes to build something that lasts.

currentProjects.title: Power of Attorney — Atlanta
currentProjects.body: Production Manager, Line Producer, and Creative Producer.

aboutTeaser.heading: About Pete
aboutTeaser.quote: Twenty-plus years in branded content, film, and TV. None of that is the point, the point is knowing where this stuff actually gets messy, and how to make it work anyway.

finalCta.heading: Need someone to lead from day one, or fix what's already slipping?
